# Vendored QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

License: MIT, as declared in the upstream source header and npm package metadata.
The license text is reproduced in `qrcode.LICENSE`; the upstream npm archive
contains the copyright header but does not include a standalone license file.

The npm tarball's SHA-512 integrity was verified before vendoring.
The encoder runs locally and makes no network requests.
